cause: The new authoring probe retained a relative output directory, then launched sandbox-exec from a nested working directory. Its profile path therefore did not exist at that location.
impact: Actual source-signature probes could not execute. The model correctly reported source unavailability; no NL0 was accepted.
repair: Resolve stage, case and probe directories before launching child processes; native launch failures are execution faults, not rejected mathematical candidates. A real relative-path probe regression now covers this CLI layout.
